It solves the integral term of the Radiative Transfer Equation (RTE) by sampling directions according to the phase function.

It differs from direct transmission estimation by focusing on the volumetric scattering contribution, and from reference path tracing by providing a specific estimator for the in-scattering term rather than a full path weight.

- Estimated in-scattered radiance $L_{\text{ins}}$.

For isotropic media, $p = \frac{1}{4\pi}$.
